name: Drag Gallery
description: Infinite two-dimensional canvas of captioned photo tiles you drag in any direction with eased momentum. Tap a tile to center and highlight it, with soft vignette edges around the viewport.
contents: Endless grid of alternating short and tall image tiles with name and numbered caption
behavior: Drag with mouse or touch to pan with eased inertia and momentum on release
Tiles are created and removed on the fly as the viewport moves, repeating the items and images endlessly
Click or tap a tile to glide it to the center and outline it, click again to deselect
editableByProps: Background and text colors, font family
Tile sizes, gaps, corner radius and vignettes
Drag smoothness, momentum, hover and focus scale

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the number of columns used for tile numbering and size alternation

fixed: Loads the Inter Tight font from Google Fonts, other font families need their own font loading
Tiles are built imperatively in the DOM and removed on unmount
Root fills the viewport height, override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto
Tile pixel sizes are fixed, on narrow screens tiles are wider than the viewport and are panned by dragging
